scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns 0 on a newly constructed PaymentHistory object before any setter is called.

execution.Arrange: Instantiate a new PaymentHistory object with no field set.
execution.Assert: Assert that the return value is 0.

scenarios.validation: Verifies default field initialization and ensures that the getter reflects uninitialized state.

scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns the value just set by setPayment_id() with a positive integer.

execution.Arrange: Instantiate PaymentHistory and call setPayment_id(42).
execution.Assert: Assert that the return value is 42.

scenarios.validation: Proves that the setter and getter form a correct roundtrip for positive values.

scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns the value most recently set after multiple successive setPayment_id() calls.

execution.Arrange: Instantiate PaymentHistory; call setPayment_id(5); then call setPayment_id(99).
execution.Assert: Assert that the return value is 99.

scenarios.validation: Checks that the last setter call overwrites previous values and that the getter always reflects the latest state.

scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns the value just set by setPayment_id() with a negative integer.

scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns 0 after calling setPayment_id(0).

scenarios.description: getPayment_id() maintains consistent value when called multiple times in succession.

execution.Act: Call getPayment_id() three times in a row.
execution.Assert: Assert that all three calls return 10.

execution.Assert: Assert that the first returns 1 and the second returns 2.

scenarios.validation: Ensures that setter/getter calls are instance-specific and not shared across instances.
